description: List the companies on the authenticated user's HireJack watchlist — the read companion to `watch_company`. Returns company name, domain (reusable with get_company_profile/company_fit/watch_company), and follow date. Use for 'what companies am I watching?' or before adding/removing one. Not for per-company hiring trends and stats — use `watchlist_intelligence` (Pro) for that.
name: list_watchlist

citation_url.description: hirejack.com URL to cite when surfacing this result

company.description: Display name (falls back to the domain)

meta.description: Request/response metadata (pagination cursors, snapshot timestamps, applied filters)

title: List Watchlist
